alice_procure: Quick sync - supplier flagged a partial hold on PO PO-80123 (H100 tranche). Expect 30/48 on-time, 18 delayed due to customs paperwork + one FW batch mismatch. Need quick decision on loaners vs payer for express.

 diego_vendor: Correct. Primary AWB (AWB-LZ1001) 30 units -> ETA 2024-11-08 AMS. Secondary AWB for 18 units pushed to 2024-11-15 pending FRA clearance. Cause: customs asked for additional ECCN doc + 2 firmware SKUs flagged in QC.

 alice_procure: What's the proposed remediation? Loaners, split express, or credit? We need cost + time delta.

 diego_vendor: Options: A) Ship 10 loaners air-export now, rest held. B) Move 18 to air-express (+$9k) for all 18, ETA moved to 2024-11-09. C) Accept delay and take 25% credit on that line. We can also combine: 10 loaners + express 8 units at reduced surcharge.

 ben_logistics: If we take express, need new AWB, docs, and expedited customs broker. Also insurance uplift and potential VAT handling. BenQ: express add-on needs payment change by EOD to hit 11/09.

 tom_finance: How much is surcharge per unit? Need to compare to cost of throttling Dedicated pools. Provide $/unit number.

 diego_vendor: Surcharge = $9k total (~$500/unit). Vendor offers to cover 40% of surcharge as goodwill if Redwood chooses credit route instead of faster ship. If Redwood pays surcharge, vendor will expedite and reduce invoice credit to 10% for delay.

 clara_ops: Cluster impact: our EU Dedicated buffer is 12 GPUs free right now. Losing 18 for a week will force us to pull from reserved burst (higher cost) or delay some internal training runs. Canary traffic must be limited. Loaners of 10 would avoid hitting burst rates.

 emma_sre: Loaners acceptable if firmware matches and serials provided. Need exact firmware numbers and a short smoke test. We'll want pre-flight logs and picture of seal.

 diego_vendor: Loaners are H100-80C fw 3.2.1 same as production baseline. We'll upload manifest and seals. Loaners are air-express shipped today if accepted. Request Redwood to sign NDA amendment for loaners (standard).

 alice_procure: NDA fine. Prefer hybrid: take 10 loaners now, expedite 8 via express with split cost (vendor covers 40% of express, Redwood covers 60%). Also accept 20% invoice credit on delayed units. @tom_finance is that acceptable?

 tom_finance: 40/60 split and 20% credit seems reasonable vs projected burst costs. Approve contingent on written amendment and chargeback workflow.

 ben_logistics: I'll schedule pickup for loaners immediately upon amendment. Confirm staging: reserve 8 inbound staging slots at AMS depot for loaners, and insurance for express AWB. 

 diego_vendor: Amendment drafted: 60% surcharge to Redwood, 40% vendor; 20% credit on delayed line items; loaners shipped today AWB LOAN-001 ETA 2024-11-06. Secondary AWB for 8 express units AWB-EXP-002 ETA 2024-11-09. Sending doc link now.

 rma_bot: [RMA-NEW] Pre-created RMA RMA-20241106-009 attached to PO-80123 delayed tranche. Status: AWAITING_PRE-FLIGHT. Deadline to attach photos/logs: 48h.

 clara_ops: Acceptance criteria for loaners: 1) boots and exposed via host, 2) `nvidia-smi` shows device, 3) passes token-bench at >= 95% of baseline, 4) KV cache hotload test success. If any fail, loaner goes straight to return RMA.

 emma_sre: Here's a tiny acceptance script we'll run on each node:

 ```bash
 # quick-h100-check
 ssh root@$NODE <<'EOF'
 nvidia-smi -L
 nvidia-smi -q | grep -E "Product|Driver Version|ECC"
 docker run --rm token-bench:latest --tokens 1024 --min-qps 1000
 EOF
 ```

 diego_vendor: We'll attach serial photos, fw dump, and quick burn-in logs to the RMA portal. For returns, vendor covers return freight for DOA and provides prepaid label to AMS depot. For firmware-mismatch related returns, vendor proposes depot-side swap v. credit; Redwood to choose.

 ben_logistics: Note on returns routing: to minimize customs churn, returns should go to AMS depot (internal). I'll coordinate the return manifest and ensure pre-alert to customs broker. Need vendor prepaid labels in advance.

 alice_procure: Action list: 1) sign amendment (I will sign once doc link is posted), 2) @ben_logistics reserve AMS inbound slots & confirm insurance, 3) @emma_sre run acceptance checks on loaners on arrival, 4) vendor upload RMA preflight photos/logs.

 diego_vendor: Amendment link posted: https://vendor-share.example.com/amendment/PO-80123. Will upload manifests and photos to the RMA id. Shipping notices inbound in 30m.

 tom_finance: Please CC finance on the amendment and new invoice terms. We'll prepare chargeback posting for surcharge.

 emma_sre: I'll post results of first two loaner checks in this thread when they arrive. If all green, we'll keep loaners in EU pool and track in asset DB.

 rma_bot: [RMA-UPDATE] RMA-20241106-009 status -> PRE-FLIGHT_PENDING (awaiting attachments).
